text:
Maple Court Apartments — Office and Contact
Leasing office hours
The leasing office is open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday
10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The office is closed Sundays and on New Year's Day, Memorial Day,
Independence Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Office and Contact

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Office and Contact
How to reach the office
Phone: (555) 0100. Email: leasing@maplecourt.example. The office is at
1400 Maple Court Drive, Springfield.

Tours are by appointment and can be booked by phone or email during office hours. This
assistant cannot book a tour; it can only explain how to request one.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Office and Contact
citation: contact-and-hours.md › How to reach the office

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Office and Contact
Emergency contact
For a maintenance emergency at any hour, call the 24-hour emergency line at
(555) 0199 and press 1. An emergency is anything that threatens safety or is causing
active damage: fire, gas odor, flooding or an active water leak, no heat below 55
degrees Fahrenheit, a total power outage inside the unit, a broken exterior door or
window lock, or a sewage backup.

If there is a fire, a gas odor, or any immediate danger to a person, call 911 first,
then call the emergency line.

Do not submit routine online maintenance requests for emergencies. The online queue is
reviewed only during office hours.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Office and Contact

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Applying
Application process
Applications are submitted online at the Maple Court resident portal, or on paper at the
leasing office during office hours. Each adult 18 or older who will live in the unit
must submit a separate application.

The application fee is $50 per adult applicant and is non-refundable. A $300 holding
deposit reserves a specific unit for up to 7 days. If the application is approved and
the lease is signed, the holding deposit is applied to the first month's rent. If the
applicant withdraws, the holding deposit is forfeited.

Processing typically takes 2 to 3 business days once all documents are received.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Applying

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Applying
Required documents
Every applicant must provide:
- A government-issued photo ID.
- Proof of income covering the last 30 days, such as two recent pay stubs, an offer
  letter, or the most recent tax return for self-employed applicants.
- Contact details for the two most recent landlords, if any.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Applying

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Applying
Screening criteria
Published screening criteria for this property are:
- Gross monthly household income of at least 3 times the monthly rent.
- No unpaid judgment from a previous landlord.
- A credit and background check, run for each adult applicant.

A co-signer is permitted when income is below the 3x threshold. A co-signer must earn at
least 5 times the monthly rent and must complete their own application.

This assistant cannot tell any individual whether they would be approved, check the
status of a submitted application, or see unit availability.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Applying

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees
Monthly rent by floor plan
These are published starting rates for a 12-month lease. Actual pricing for a specific
unit is quoted by the leasing office.

- Studio, about 480 square feet: $1,150 per month.
- One bedroom, about 650 square feet: $1,375 per month.
- Two bedroom, two bath, about 925 square feet: $1,790 per month.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees
citation: rent-and-fees.md › Monthly rent by floor plan

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees
Security deposit
The standard security deposit is one month's rent. It is refundable after move-out,
less any deductions for damage beyond normal wear, unpaid charges, or cleaning beyond
standard turnover.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees
Recurring monthly charges
Added to rent each month:
- Water, sewer and trash: $65 flat per unit.
- Pet rent, if applicable: $35 per pet per month.
- Reserved parking, if applicable: $40 per space per month.

Electricity and internet are billed directly by the provider and are the resident's
responsibility. They are not collected by Maple Court.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees
One-time and situational fees
- Application fee: $50 per adult, non-refundable.
- Holding deposit: $300, applied to first month's rent if the lease is signed.
- Pet fee: $250 per pet, one time, non-refundable.
- Late rent fee: $75, charged once rent is more than 5 days late.
- Returned payment fee: $35.
- Replacement key or fob: $25.
- Lost parking decal: $15.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees
When rent is due
Rent is due on the 1st of each month. Payments received after the 5th incur the $75 late
fee. Payment methods are the resident portal, or a check or money order delivered to the
leasing office during office hours. Cash is not accepted.

This assistant cannot see any individual's balance, payment history, or lease charges.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Published Rent and Fees

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Standard lease length
The standard lease is 12 months. A 6-month lease is available at $150 per month above
the published rate for that floor plan. Month-to-month is available only after a
completed 12-month lease, at $300 per month above the published rate.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Renewal
Renewal offers are sent 90 days before the lease end date. The resident must respond at
least 60 days before the end date. A lease that is not renewed and not ended with proper
notice converts to month-to-month at the month-to-month rate.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Notice to vacate
Written notice to vacate is required at least 60 days before the intended move-out date.
Notice must be submitted in writing through the resident portal or delivered to the
leasing office.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Breaking a lease early
Early termination requires 60 days written notice plus a termination fee of two months'
rent. The security deposit is handled separately and is not applied to the termination
fee.

Residents with active military orders may terminate under the Servicemembers Civil
Relief Act with a copy of the orders; the termination fee does not apply in that case.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Occupancy
Occupancy is limited to 2 people per bedroom plus 1. A studio allows up to 2 occupants.
Guests staying longer than 14 consecutive days must be added to the lease.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Subletting
Subletting and short-term rental listings are not permitted.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Quiet hours
Quiet hours are 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM daily.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms
Smoking
Maple Court is entirely smoke-free, including inside units, on balconies, and in all
common areas. This includes vaping. A smoking violation carries a $250 charge.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Lease Terms

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy
What is allowed
Cats and dogs are welcome, with a limit of 2 pets per unit. There is no weight limit.

The following dog breeds are not permitted: Pit Bull, Rottweiler, Doberman Pinscher,
Chow Chow, Akita, and any wolf hybrid.

Fish tanks up to 20 gallons are allowed and are not counted as pets. Caged birds and
small caged animals are allowed and are not counted as pets. Reptiles are not permitted.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy
Pet charges
- Pet fee: $250 per pet, one time, non-refundable. This is a fee, not a deposit, so it
  is not returned at move-out.
- Pet rent: $35 per pet per month, added to the monthly rent.

There is no separate refundable pet deposit at this property.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy
Documentation
Each pet requires a current rabies vaccination record and a photo on file with the
leasing office. Pets must be registered before move-in or within 7 days of being
brought into the unit.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy
Service and assistance animals
Verified service animals and approved assistance animals are not pets under this policy.
The pet fee, pet rent, breed restrictions and the 2-pet limit do not apply to them.
Documentation is handled by the leasing office under fair housing rules; this assistant
cannot review or approve such documentation.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy
Pet rules on the property
Dogs must be leashed in all common areas. Waste must be picked up immediately; stations
are provided near the mail kiosk and by the dog run. A $100 charge applies per
documented failure to remove pet waste. Pets may not be left unattended on balconies.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Pet Policy
citation: pets.md › Pet rules on the property

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Parking
Resident parking
Each unit receives 1 unreserved surface parking space at no additional charge. A parking
decal is issued at move-in and must be displayed on the rear windshield. A replacement
decal costs $15.

Reserved covered spaces in the garage are available for $40 per space per month, subject
to availability. The leasing office maintains the reserved-space waitlist; this
assistant cannot check the waitlist or reserve a space.

A unit may hold at most 2 parking spaces total, in any combination of unreserved and
reserved.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Parking

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Parking
Guest parking
Guest spaces are marked GUEST near the leasing office and are limited to 24 consecutive
hours. Guests staying overnight for more than one night need a temporary pass from the
leasing office.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Parking

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Parking
Towing
Vehicles are towed at the owner's expense for parking without a decal, parking in a
reserved space not assigned to them, blocking a fire lane or dumpster, or parking in an
accessible space without proper plates or placard.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Parking

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Parking
Vehicle restrictions
Vehicle repairs and oil changes are not permitted on the property. Inoperable or
unregistered vehicles may not be stored on the property. RVs, boats and trailers are not
permitted.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Parking

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Parking
Electric vehicles
There are 4 shared EV charging spaces in the garage, available first come first served,
limited to 4 hours per session. Charging is billed at $0.30 per kilowatt-hour through
the charging provider's own app.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Parking

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Amenities
Hours and access
All amenities are opened with the resident key fob. A lost fob costs $25 to replace.

- Fitness center: open daily, 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
- Pool: open seasonally, May 1 through September 30, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. There is no
  lifeguard; residents swim at their own risk.
- Resident lounge and co-working room: open daily, 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. The lounge can
  be reserved for private events through the leasing office for a $75 fee plus a $150
  refundable cleaning deposit.
- Package room: accessible 24 hours with a fob. Packages are held 10 days, then returned
  to the carrier.
- Laundry: each unit has a full-size washer and dryer. There is no shared laundry room.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Amenities

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Amenities
Other amenities
A fenced dog run is located behind building C. Outdoor grills are by the pool deck and
are first come first served. Bicycle storage is in the garage; bikes must be registered
with the leasing office. There is no on-site storage unit rental at this property.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Amenities

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Amenities
Guests at amenities
Residents may bring up to 2 guests to the pool or fitness center and must accompany them
at all times. Guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult resident.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Amenities

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Amenities
Wi-Fi
Common-area Wi-Fi is provided in the lounge and pool deck. In-unit internet is arranged
by the resident directly with a provider.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Amenities

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance
Routine maintenance requests
Routine requests are submitted through the resident portal, by phone to (555) 0100
during office hours, or in person at the leasing office. A request should include the
unit number, a description of the problem, and whether there is a pet in the unit.

Target response times, measured in business days:
- Urgent but not an emergency, such as a refrigerator not cooling or a single
  non-functioning toilet in a two-bath unit: next business day.
- Routine, such as a dripping faucet, a loose cabinet handle, or a burned-out common
  fixture: 3 business days.
- Cosmetic, such as paint touch-up or a scuffed baseboard: scheduled as workload allows.

These are targets, not guarantees.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance
Entry for maintenance
Maintenance staff may enter with at least 24 hours notice, except in an emergency, when
entry may occur without notice. Residents may request to be present; this must be noted
on the request and may extend the schedule.

If a pet is in the unit, note it on the request. Technicians will not enter a unit with
an unsecured animal.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance
Emergency maintenance
For an emergency, call the 24-hour emergency line at (555) 0199 and press 1. Do not use
the online queue, which is reviewed only during office hours.

An emergency is: fire, a gas odor, flooding or an active water leak, no heat when the
outside temperature is below 55 degrees Fahrenheit, a total loss of power inside the
unit, a broken exterior door or window lock, or a sewage backup.

For fire, gas odor, or any immediate danger to a person, call 911 first, then the
emergency line.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance
Charges for repairs
Normal wear and tear is repaired at no cost to the resident. Charges apply for damage
caused by the resident, a guest or a pet. Published examples:
- Garbage disposal jam caused by improper use: $75.
- Drain clog caused by wipes, grease or foreign objects: $125.
- Lockout after office hours: $50.
- Broken window or door glass: billed at actual cost.
- Missed appointment where the resident requested to be present: $40.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance
Filters and resident upkeep
Air filters are replaced quarterly by maintenance at no charge. Residents are
responsible for replacing their own light bulbs in unit fixtures and batteries in smoke
detectors, and for keeping drains free of grease and foreign objects.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Maintenance

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
Before move-in
Before keys are released, the resident must have:
- A signed lease from every adult occupant.
- The first month's rent and the security deposit paid in full.
- Proof of renters insurance with at least $100,000 in liability coverage, naming Maple
  Court Apartments as an interested party.
- Utilities for electricity transferred into the resident's name effective the move-in
  date.

Keys are released at the leasing office during office hours on or after the lease start
date. Keys are not released outside office hours.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
Move-in inspection
A move-in condition form is provided with the keys. It must be completed and returned
within 5 days. Anything not noted on that form may be treated as resident damage at
move-out.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
Moving hours and elevator
Moving is permitted 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily. The service elevator in buildings B and C
can be reserved through the leasing office at no charge. Moving trucks may not block
fire lanes or the trash enclosure.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
Notice and move-out
Written notice to vacate is required at least 60 days before the move-out date, through
the resident portal or in writing at the leasing office.

A pre-move-out walkthrough can be requested in the final 2 weeks. It is optional and
identifies likely deductions in advance.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
Move-out condition
At move-out the unit must be empty, broom clean, with all keys, fobs and parking decals
returned to the leasing office. Carpets must be professionally cleaned, with the receipt
left in the unit or emailed to the office. Nail holes should be patched; full repainting
is not required unless walls were painted a non-standard color without approval.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
Security deposit return
The security deposit, less any deductions, is returned within 30 days of move-out to the
forwarding address on file. An itemized statement of deductions is included. Residents
must provide a forwarding address at move-out.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out

text:
Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
Common deductions
Published examples of deductions beyond normal wear:
- Full unit cleaning if left unclean: $200.
- Carpet cleaning if not professionally cleaned: $150.
- Unreturned key, fob or decal: $25 each.
- Wall repair beyond nail holes: billed at actual cost.
- Trash or belongings left behind: $100 minimum, plus disposal cost.

This assistant cannot calculate any individual's deposit return or see any account.
title: Maple Court Apartments — Move-In and Move-Out
